known_world_facts: Leyra is an eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer based at Vellum Hall.
Ashen Gate is legally recorded as sealed and has not been formally reopened.
Greyfen lies beside the eastern ward-line and depends on stable boundary maps.
A legal map-seal requires witnessed survey evidence; private marks and rumors are not enough.
Crossing a sealed boundary without authorization can end an apprenticeship.
Master Ilyan trained Leyra and has never given her a clear account of his earlier Ashen Gate work.
No accepted evidence currently proves why old roads sometimes appear to return.
